text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
I kind of feel like I need to get more distance runs in—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I need to head back and consult with Trainer-san.
I wonder if they're still around...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. And then I also need to ask for fishing gear so you can go fishing with me~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Honestly, Sei-chan.
We never scheduled anything like that, did we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oops, is that so?
How disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Well, putting that aside.
Grass-chan, you've seemed a bit different lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...? Really?
I haven't noticed anything myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, what are you saying? The very first words
out of your mouth when in trouble are 'I need to consult someone'?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, who rarely ever relies on others...
Mother's tears of joy are blinding her vision~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, honestly.
Since when did you become my mother, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I had no idea whatsoever~.
From now on, I'll call you "Mother"♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Of course, both in the dorm and the classroom.
Now, shall we go introduce you to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, ahaha~.
I-I think I'll go run a little bit more~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: “—Geez. I wonder if I can talk to Trainer normally while feeling this giddy~.”
